content: {"reasoning":"Prior authorization is missing, and silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; an appeal also requires a denial first. The claim is within timely filing, with valid coding and correct COB, so submitting it with supporting records can obtain an adjudication and establish the medical-necessity record without assuming the authorization requirement is waived.
